qe: Which Article of the Constitution was described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?
qh: डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर ने किस अनुच्छेद को संविधान का 'हृदय और आत्मा' कहा था?
e: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ne Article 32 ko samvidhan ka 'hriday aur aatma' (heart and soul) kaha tha - kyunki yahi wo pravdhan hai jo kisi bhi vyakti ko uske mool adhikaron (fundamental rights) ki raksha ke liye seedha Supreme Court jaane ka adhikar deta hai. Iske teht Supreme Court paanch tarah ke writ (aadesh) jaari karti hai - habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, certiorari aur quo warranto; isi shakti ke saath Article 226 ke teht High Court bhi writ de sakti hai. Article 19 keval azaadiyon ki suchi hai, Article 21 jeevan ki suraksha hai aur Article 14 samanata ka - par in sab ki raksha ka darwaza 'heart and soul' wala Article 32 hi hai. Exam point: Article 32 = samvidhan ki aatma, writ jaari karne ki shakti; HC ke liye yehi kaam Article 226 karta hai.

qe: By which Constitutional Amendment Act was the 'Right to Property' removed from the list of Fundamental Rights?
qh: 'संपत्ति के अधिकार' को किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा मौलिक अधिकारों की सूची से हटाया गया था?
e: 'Sampti ka adhikar' (Right to Property) pehle ek mool adhikar (Article 31) tha, lekin 44th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1978 ne usse Part III (mool adhikaron) se hata kar Article 300A ke teht ek vidhik (legal) adhikar bana diya - iska matlab hai ki ab uske ullanghan par seedha Article 32 wala writ nahi milta, balki samanya kanoon ke teht adalat mein mukadma chalaya ja sakta hai. 42th sanshodhan (1976) ne 10 mool kartavya (Part IVA) joden, 86th (2002) shiksha ka adhikar diya aur 52th (1985) dal-badal (anti-defection) se juda tha - isliye sampti wala kaam 44th sanshodhan ka hai. Exam point: sampti ka adhikar Part III se hata = 44th sanshodhan 1978 (ab Article 300A ka vidhik adhikar).

qe: Which Fundamental Rights under Part III cannot be suspended even during a proclamation of National Emergency under Article 352?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी भाग III के कौन से मौलिक अधिकार निलंबित नहीं किए जा सकते?
e: Rashtrapati jab Article 352 ke teht 'rashtriya aapatkal' (National Emergency) ghoshit karte hain, to Article 358 aur 359 ke teht mool adhikar nirast (suspension) ho sakte hain - par Article 20 (apraadh ke liye saza se juda samrakshan) aur Article 21 (jeevan aur daivi swatantrata) kabhi suspend nahi hote. Ye vyavastha 44th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1978 se aayi - usse pehle aapatkal mein sabhi mool adhikar suspend ho sakte the, jiska durupyog 1975 wale Emergency mein dekha gaya tha (ADM Jabalpur case). Adalat is niyam ko sabse mahatvapurn suraksha kavach maanti hai, kyunki isse jeevan aur nyay ka adhikar hamesha zinda rehta hai. Exam point: aapatkal mein bhi Article 20 aur 21 suspend nahi hote (44th sanshodhan, 1978); Article 358 sirf Article 19 ko suspend karta hai.

qe: Under Article 21A, the State is mandated to provide free and compulsory education to all children of which age group?
qh: अनुच्छेद 21A के तहत राज्य किस आयु वर्ग के बच्चों को मुफ्त और अनिवार्य शिक्षा देने के लिए बाध्य है?
e: 86th samvidhan sanshodhan, 2002 dwara joda gaya Article 21A kehta hai ki rajya 6 se 14 saal ke sabhi bachchon ko muft aur anivarya shiksha (free and compulsory education) dega - usi sanshodhan se ye shiksha ek mool adhikar ban gayi, aur ise lagu karne ke liye Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 (RTE Act) banaya gaya. 0-6 saal wale bachchon ke liye anganwadi, poshan (nutrition) aur shishu dekhbhal ki vyavastha Article 45 (DPSP) aur ICDS scheme dekhti hai; 6-18 wale bade bachchon ke liye alag yojnayein hain. Isliye '0 se 6', '3 se 12' ya '6 se 18' wale vikalp galat hain - samvidhan mein 6 se 14 hi likha hai. Exam point: Article 21A = 6-14 saal ke bachchon ko muft-anivarya shiksha (86th sanshodhan 2002, RTE Act 2009).

qe: Which Writ is issued by constitutional courts to secure the release of a person who has been unlawfully detained?
qh: अवैध रूप से हिरासत में लिए गए व्यक्ति को रिहा कराने के लिए अदालत द्वारा कौन सी रिट जारी की जाती है?
e: 'Habeas Corpus' ka matlab hai 'tumhara shareer hamare paas aaye' (to have the body) - ye writ us samay jaari hoti hai jab kisi vyakti ko avaidh roop se (bina uchit aadhar ke) hirasat (detention) mein rakha gaya ho. Iske teht adalat hirasat mein rakhe gaye vyakti ko apne saamne bulwati hai aur sarkar se hirasat ka kaaran poochti hai; agar kaaran santoshjanak na ho to vyakti ko turant chhodne ka aadesh diya jaata hai. Ye writ sarkar ke saath-saath niji vyakti ke khilaf bhi jaari ho sakti hai, aur yahi ek aisa pravdhan hai jo aapatkal mein bhi sambhav rehta hai. Certiorari nyayik aadesh quash karne ke liye, mandamus kisi kaam karane ke liye aur quo warranto pad ki vaidhata jaanchne ke liye hoti hai. Exam point: avaidh hirasat se mukti ka writ = Habeas Corpus (sarkar ya niji vyakti ke khilaf bhi).

qe: Article 17 of the Constitution provides for the abolition of which social evil?
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 17 किस सामाजिक बुराई के उन्मूलन का प्रावधान करता है?
e: Article 17 ke teht 'asprishyata' (untouchability) ka acharan (practice) kisi bhi roop mein samapt kar diya gaya hai, aur iska palan karana vidhi dwara gair-kanooni (illegal) hai - achhoot kahna, mandir mein aane se rokna, khane-peene ya chhune par rok lagana sabhi iske daayre mein aate hain. Iske kareenne ke liye Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 aur SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 jaise kanoon banaye gaye; Article 17 aur 23 wale aapraadhon ke liye saza tay karne ki shakti Article 35 ke teht keval Parliament ke paas hai. Manav traficking (Article 23) aur bal shram (Article 24) alag pravdhan hain, aur 'vanshanugat upadhiyan' (hereditary titles) ka sambandh Article 18 se hai. Exam point: Article 17 = asprishyata ka unmulan; saza ke liye kendra ka kanoon Protection of Civil Rights Act 1955.

qe: The concept of 'Directive Principles of State Policy' (DPSP) in Part IV was borrowed from the constitution of which country?
qh: 'राज्य के नीति निर्देशक तत्व' (DPSP) किस देश के संविधान से लिए गए हैं?
e: 'Nirdeshak tatvon' (Directive Principles of State Policy) wala Part IV samvidhan mein Ireland ke samvidhan se liya gaya hai (aur Ireland ne ye shareer Spain se liya tha). Inka maksad yahi hai ki sarkar apni nitiyon mein logon ke kalyan, samajik nyay aur vikas ko praathamikta de - ye niti ke nirdesh hain, jo adalat dwara seedhe agya sak nahi hote (non-justiciable), par desh ke shaasan ke liye margdarshak hain. America se mool adhikar (Fundamental Rights), Australia se samanvay (concurrent list) aur Canada se sanghiy (federation) vyavastha bhaari hai; isliye DPSP ka jod Ireland hi hai. Exam point: DPSP = Ireland se liye (Part IV, Article 36-51), adalat mein seedhe lagu nahi hote.

qe: Article 44 of the Directive Principles directs the State to secure which uniform measure for all citizens?
qh: नीति निर्देशक तत्वों का अनुच्छेद 44 नागरिकों के लिए क्या सुनिश्चित करने का निर्देश देता है?
o: Free legal aid across all courts
e: Article 44 (DPSP) kehta hai ki rajya apne nagrikon ke liye ek saman nagar kanoon (Uniform Civil Code) lagane ki koshish karega - yani vivaah, talaq, gyaarasi (inheritance) aur god lene (adoption) jaise zaati (personal) kanoonon ko sabhi dharmon ke logon ke liye saman banane ka nirdesh hai. Ye nirdesh aaj tak pura nahi hua, jo samaya-samay par charcha ka vishay banta hai. 'Saman nyoontam vetan', 'muft vidhik sahayata' aur 'sansadhanon ka saman vitaran' alag-alag DPSPs hain (Article 43, 39A aur 39(b)) - isliye UCC wala sahi jod Article 44 hai. Exam point: saman nagar kanoon (UCC) = Article 44; ispar aadesh nahi, nirdesh hai (DPSP).

qe: Protection against 'Double Jeopardy' is guaranteed under which clause of the Constitution?
qh: 'दोहरे दंड' (Double Jeopardy) से संरक्षण किस अनुच्छेद के तहत प्रदान किया गया है?
e: 'Dohra khatra' (Double Jeopardy) se raksha Article 20(2) deta hai - iske anusaar kisi vyakti par ek hi aapraadh ke liye do baar mukadma (prosecution) aur saza nahi di ja sakti; ye 'autrefois convict' ke usool par khada hai jo angrezi aam kanoon se aaya. Iska lagu hona keval adalaton aur nyayik karyavahi par hai - sarkar ki prashasnik karyavahi (jaise videshi karyavahi ya vishleshan) par nahi. Article 20 ka poora parivar ek hi aapraadh ke teen pehlu dekhta hai: 20(1) kanoon se pehle ki saza nahi (ex post facto), 20(2) dohri saza nahi, aur 20(3) khud ke khilaf gawahi nahi. Article 21 jeevan ka, 19 bhaashn ka aur 22(1) vakil ke adhikar ka pravdhan hai. Exam point: double jeopardy = Article 20(2); 20(1) ex-post-facto aur 20(3) self-incrimination ke liye hai.

qe: Which Article of the Directive Principles mandates the State to separate the Judiciary from the Executive in public services?
qh: नीति निर्देशक तत्वों का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कार्यपालिका से न्यायपालिका को अलग करने का निर्देश देता है?
e: Article 50 (DPSP) kehta hai ki rajya lok sevaon mein nyayapalika (judiciary) ko karyapalika (executive) se alag rakhne ke liye kadam uthega - yani jaanchna-anshch (magistrates) ke haath se nikal kar swatantra nyayapalika ke paas jaana chahiye. Isi nirdesh ke teht 1970 ke aas-paas alag nyayik seva (judicial service) aur prashasnik nyayadhiish wale alag pad (Civil Judge/JMFC) bane, jisse nyay ki nishpakshata badhi. Article 48A paryavaran ke sanrakshan ka, Article 51 antarrashtriya shanti ka aur Article 44 saman nagar kanoon ka nirdesh deta hai - so inmein se kisi ka nyayapalika ke alag hone se sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: nyayapalika ko karyapalika se alag karna = Article 50 (DPSP); isi ke teht alag nyayik seva/nyayadhiish vyavastha bani.

qe: Under Article 19(1), how many fundamental democratic freedoms are currently guaranteed to Indian citizens?
qh: अनुच्छेद 19(1) के तहत वर्तमान में भारतीय नागरिकों को कितने प्रकार की स्वतंत्रताएं प्राप्त हैं?
e: Article 19(1) mein aaj 6 azaadiyan hain - (a) bhaashn aur abhivyakti, (b) shanti se ekatrit hona (assembly), (c) sangh ya union banana, (d) bharat mein kahin bhi ghoomna-phirna (movement), (e) bharat ke kisi bhi bhaag mein nivas (residence), aur (g) koi bhi pesha, vyapar ya dhandha karne ki azaadi. Pehle 7 azaadiyan thi, par 'sampti rakhne ke adhikar' (right to property wala 19(1)(f)) ko 44th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1978 ne hata diya, isliye ab ginti 6 ki hai. Ye adhikaron par uchit prabandh (reasonable restrictions) bhi lagte hain - jaise 19(2) ke teht bhaashn par. Exam point: Article 19(1) mein ab 6 azaadiyan (19(1)(f) sampti hata diye jaane ke baad); (a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (g).

qe: Articles 25 to 28 of the Indian Constitution collectively guarantee which category of rights?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 25 से 28 सामूहिक रूप से किस श्रेणी के अधिकार की गारंटी देते हैं?
e: Article 25 se 28 tak 'dharm ki swatantrata' (Right to Freedom of Religion) ke pravdhan hain - Article 25 sabhi vyaktiyon ko dharma maanne, apnane aur apne dharm ka pracar karne ki azaadi deta hai, Article 26 dharmik sansthaon ko apne mamlon khud chalane ka adhikar deta hai, Article 27 dharm ke pracar ke liye khas kar (tax) lene par rok lagata hai, aur Article 28 shiksha sansthaon mein dharmik path padhane ke niyam tay karta hai. Article 32 sanvidhanik upay (writ) ka, Article 14 samanata ka aur Article 29-30 sanskritik tatha shiksha adhikaron ka pravdhan hai - isliye 25 se 28 ka samuh 'dharm ki swatantrata' hi hai. Exam point: Article 25-28 = dharm ki swatantrata; 29-30 = sanskritik aur shiksha adhikar; 32 = samvidhanik upay.

qe: Under Article 39A, what constitutional mandate is imposed upon the State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 39A के तहत राज्य पर क्या संवैधानिक दायित्व सौंपा गया है?
o: To ensure equal pay for equal work
To enforce prohibition of intoxicating drinks
To provide free legal aid by suitable legislation to ensure justice is not denied due to economic disabilities
e: Article 39A (42th sanshodhan, 1976 dwara joda gaya) kehta hai ki rajya apni vidhik vyavastha ko aise tay karega jisse nyay prapt karne ke avsar (opportunities) saman hon aur koi bhi vyakti aarthik ya anya ashaktata (economic or other disabilities) ke kaaran nyay se vanchit (denied) na rahe - isi ke teht muft vidhik sahayata (free legal aid) aur lok adalat ki vyavastha bani, NALSA (National Legal Services Authority) ka gathan hua aur garib kaidiyon ko vakil mila. Panchayat (Article 40), saman vetan (Article 39(d)) aur madya-nishedh (Article 47) alag-alag DPSPs hain - ye sab alag nirdesh hain aur Article 39A ke dayre mein nahi aate. Exam point: muft vidhik sahayata = Article 39A (DPSP, 42th sanshodhan); isi ke teht NALSA aur Lok Adalat ki vyavastha.

qe: The concept of 'Rule of Law' incorporated in Article 14 was fundamentally derived from the constitutional jurisprudence of:
qh: अनुच्छेद 14 में शामिल 'कानून का शासन' (Rule of Law) की अवधारणा किस देश के न्यायशास्त्र से ली गई है?
e: Article 14 wala 'vidhi ka shasan' (Rule of Law) ka siddhant (doctrine) angrezi (British) aam kanoon aur A.V. Dicey ki vichardhara se aaya hai - iske anusaar koi vyakti kanoon se upar nahi hai, sabhi nagrik saman kanoon ke saamne khade hain, kanoon ke bina kisi ki swatantrata ya sampatti nahi chhini ja sakti, aur kanoon keval vidhayak (legislature) dwara banaya jaayega. America se mool adhikar, Australia se samanvay suchi aur France se gantantriya soch li gayi, par samanata ka nootan (rule of law) angrezi ya fransisi vichardhara nahi, angrezi aam kanoon hai. Exam point: Article 14 ka 'rule of law' = Britain (English common law, Dicey ka siddhant); samanata ke do roop - equality before law (British) aur equal protection (American).

qe: Under Article 23 of the Constitution, which specific exploitative practices are prohibited?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 23 के तहत किन शोषणकारी प्रथाओं पर रोक लगाई गई है?
o: Traffic in human beings, begar, and other similar forms of forced labour
e: Article 23 'manav traficking', 'begar' (bina mazdoori ka jabar, yani begar karvana) aur anya milte-julte jabar (forced labour) ke roopon ko samapt karta hai - yani kisi vyakti ko jabar se ya kam vetan par jaisa hai kam karne ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta. Is pravdhan ke do apvaad hain: rashtriya hit ke liye sarkar dwara thopaya gaya anivarya seva (compulsory service), aur sainya (military) ke liye anivarya seva. Bachchon ko khatarnak kaam par rokna alag pravdhan (Article 24) hai aur asprishyata Article 17 ka vishay hai, isliye unhe is vikalp ka sahi jod nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: Article 23 = manav traficking, begar aur forced labour ka nishedh; apvaad - anivarya sarkari seva aur sainya seva.

qe: Which Article of the Directive Principles serves as the constitutional foundation for India's foreign policy on international peace?
qh: नीति निर्देशक तत्वों का कौन सा अनुच्छेद अंतरराष्ट्रीय शांति पर भारत की विदेश नीति का आधार है?
e: Article 51 (DPSP) rajya ko nirdesh deta hai ki wo antarrashtriya shanti aur suraksha ko badhane, deshon ke beech nyayapurn aur sammanjanak sambandh banane, antarrashtriya kanoon aur sandhiyon (treaties) ka samman karne, aur antarrashtriya vivadon ka samadhan vaarta (negotiation), madhyastha (mediation), salaah (arbitration) ya nyayik nirnay se karane ka prayas karega - yani Bharat ki videsh niti (foreign policy) ka samvidhanik aadhar yahi nirdesh hai. Isi ke saath 51A mein har nagrik ka kartavya hai ki wo anya deshon ke saath shanti aur bhaichare ko badhaye. Article 50 nyayapalika ke alag hone ka aur Article 48A paryavaran ke sanrakshan ka nirdesh deta hai - dono alag vishay hain. Exam point: Article 51 = antarrashtriya shanti aur suraksha ka nirdesh (DPSP), Bharat ki videsh niti ka samvidhanik adhaar.

qe: Under Article 24, children below what age are strictly prohibited from being employed in hazardous factories or mines?
qh: अनुच्छेद 24 के तहत किस आयु से कम के बच्चों को कारखानों या खानों जैसे जोखिम भरे कार्यों में नियोजित करने पर पूर्ण प्रतिबंध है?
e: Article 24 ke anusaar 14 saal se kam umar ke kisi bachche ko karkhane (factories), khaddan (mines) ya khatarnaak (hazardous) kaam mein ya nirmaan/railway jaise anya risky kaam par lagaya nahi ja sakta - iska maksad bachchon ki sehat aur bachpan bachana hai. 14 se 18 saal ke kishoron ke liye alag niyam hain (Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act ke teht khatarnak kaam par rok, aur khatarnak nahi to samay aur shartein tay), aur 2016 ke sanshodhan ne 14 saal se kam umar wale bachchon ka kaam parivarik udyog (family enterprise) mein bhi seemit kiya. 12, 16 ya 18 wale vikalp samvidhan ke aankde se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: Article 24 = 14 saal se kam bachche karkhane, khaddan ya khatarnak kaam par nahi; RTE (Article 21A) bhi 6-14 saal ke liye hai.

qe: Which Landmark Case established the 'Basic Structure Doctrine', limiting Parliament's amending power under Article 368?
qh: किस ऐतिहासिक मामले ने 'मूल संरचना सिद्धांत' स्थापित कर अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत संसद की संशोधन शक्ति को सीमित किया?
o: A.K. Gopalan v. State of Madras (1950)
Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)
Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980)
e: 'Aadharik sanrachna siddhant' (Basic Structure Doctrine) Kesavananda Bharati badantam v. State of Kerala (1973) mein 13 nyadhiishon ki bench ne sthapit kiya - usne kaha ki Parliament Article 368 ke teht samvidhan mein sanshodhan kar sakti hai, lekin samvidhan ki 'aadharik sanrachna' (basic structure) ko nasht nahi kar sakti: jaise samvidhan ka sarvochchata, nyayik punaravalokan (judicial review), shaktiyon ka baantwara, dharmanirapekshata. Golaknath (1967) ne kaha tha ki mool adhikar sanshodhit nahi ho sakte, aur Minerva Mills (1980) ne 42th sanshodhan ke kuchh khandon (Article 368(4)-(5)) ko isi siddhant ke aadhar par nirast kiya. A.K. Gopalan (1950) ek purana nirnay tha jismein preventive detention ka mamla tha. Exam point: basic structure = Kesavananda Bharati (1973); Golaknath (1967) uske raaste ka pehla kadam, Minerva Mills (1980) ne 42th sanshodhan ke kuchh hisse rad kiye.

qe: Article 15(1) prohibits the State from discriminating against any citizen on which specific grounds?
qh: अनुच्छेद 15(1) राज्य को अपने नागरिकों के खिलाफ किन विशिष्ट आधारों पर भेदभाव करने से रोकता है?
o: Only on grounds of Religion, Race, Caste, Sex, Place of birth or any of them
e: Article 15(1) ke anusaar rajya kisi bhi nagrik ke saath keval dharm (religion), mool-vansh (race), jaati (caste), ling (sex) aur janma-sthaan (place of birth) ke aadhar par bhedbhav nahi kar sakta - inhe 'nirdharak aadhar' (grounds of discrimination) kaha jaata hai. Yahi khaayat hai ki in aadhar par bhedbhav se samanata ka mool adhikar tootta hai, isliye pani-quan ki tarah sabhi ko ek jaisa mauka milna chahiye; dhyaan rahe ki anuchhed mein 'nationality' ya 'political affiliation' jaise aadhar nahi hain. Iske alava Article 15(3) mahilaon-bachchon ke liye, 15(4) picchde vargon (SEBC/SC-ST) ke liye aur 15(5) shiksha sansthaon mein OBC ke liye vishesh pravdhan (special provisions) ki chhoot dete hain. Exam point: Article 15(1) ke paanch aadhar = dharma, race, caste, sex, place of birth; 15(3)/(4)/(5) vishesh pravdhan ki chhoot dete hain.

qe: Under Article 22(2), an arrested individual must be produced before the nearest Magistrate within what maximum time window?
qh: अनुच्छेद 22(2) के तहत गिरफ्तार व्यक्ति को कितने समय के भीतर निकटतम मजिस्ट्रेट के समक्ष पेश किया जाना अनिवार्य है?
o: Within 24 hours (excluding journey time from place of arrest to court)
e: Article 22(2) ke anusaar giraftar (arrest) kiye gaye vyakti ko 24 ghante ke andar nazdeeki nyayadhiish (Magistrate) ke saamne pesh karna zaroori hai - is samay mein giraftari se adalat tak ki yatra (journey) ka samay shaamil nahi hota. Iske peeche tark yahi hai ki sarkar kisi ko bina nyayik nirikshan ke lamba band na rakh sake; agar 24 ghante mein pesh nahi kiya gaya to hirasat avaidh (illegal) maani jaati hai aur habeas corpus writ ka raasta khulta hai. Article 22(1) ke teht giraftar vyakti ko giraftari ka kaaran jaanne aur vakil se milne ka adhikar bhi milta hai. 12, 48 ya 72 ghante ye aankde samvidhan ke 24 ghante wale niyam se alag hain (12 ghante ek purani dhara/niyam mein tha, samvidhan mein 24 ghante hai). Exam point: giraftari ke 24 ghante andar (yatra samay chhod kar) nazdeeki nyayadhiish ke saamne peshi - Article 22(2).

qe: Article 30 confers the fundamental right to establish and administer educational institutions to which specific classes of citizens?
qh: अनुच्छेद 30 किन वर्गों को शैक्षणिक संस्थान स्थापित करने और उनका प्रशासन करने का मौलिक अधिकार प्रदान करता है?
o: Any section of citizens having a distinct language, script, or culture
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes exclusively
e: Article 30 ke anusaar sabhi dharmik ya bhaashik alpsankhyakon (religious or linguistic minorities) ko apni pasand ke shiksha sansthan sthapit karne aur unka prashasan (administer) karne ka mool adhikar hai - yani har alpsankhyak samuday apni bhasha, sanskriti aur dharm ke anusaar padhai karane wali sanstha khol sakta hai. Isi tarah Article 29 sanskritik aur shiksha adhikaron ki raksha karta hai (kisi bhi varg ke nagrik apni sanskriti-bhasha-script bachaye rakh sakte hain). Ye keval Aarthik Roop Se Kamzor Varg (EWS) ya SC-ST ke liye nahi hai - wo toh Article 15(5)/16(4) jaise aarakshan wale pravdhan hain, alag mamla hai. Exam point: Article 30 = dharmik aur bhaashik alpsankhyakon ke shiksha sansthan banane/chalane ka adhikar; Article 29 = sanskritik-bhasha-script ki raksha.

qe: The writ of 'Mandamus' literally translates to which command, and against whom can it NOT be issued?
qh: 'परमादेश' (Mandamus) रिट का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है और यह किसके खिलाफ जारी नहीं की जा सकती?
o: 'To have the Body'; cannot be issued against police officers
'To be Certified'; cannot be issued against lower courts
'By what Authority'; cannot be issued against municipal corporations
'We Command'; cannot be issued against the President of India or a State Governor
e: 'Mandamus' ka shabdaarth hai 'ham aadesh dete hain' (We Command) - ye writ kisi lok adhikari ya sarkari sanstha ko ye kaam karne ke liye jaari hoti hai ki wo apna kanooni kartavya pura kare, jise usne karne se inkaar kiya ho. Iska khaas niyam yahi hai ki ye rashtrapati ya rajya ke Rajyapal ke khilaf jaari nahi ho sakti (kyunki unhe Article 361 samrakshan milta hai), aur niji vyakti ke khilaf bhi nahi jaari hoti (wo kisi 'public duty' mein nahi hai). 'To have the Body' habeas corpus ka, 'To be Certified' certiorari ka aur 'By what Authority' quo warranto ka arth hai - isliye is prashna ka sahi jod 'We Command' hi hai. Exam point: mandamus = We Command; rashtrapati/Rajyapal aur niji vyakti ke khilaf nahi - keval lok adhikari/sanstha ke khilaf.

qe: Under Article 31C, which Directive Principles are given precedence over Fundamental Rights under Articles 14 and 19?
qh: अनुच्छेद 31C के तहत किन DPSP को अनुच्छेद 14 और 19 के मौलिक अधिकारों पर प्राथमिकता दी गई है?
o: Article 39(b) [distribution of material resources] and Article 39(c) [prevention of concentration of wealth]
e: Article 31C (25th sanshodhan, 1971 se aaya) kehta hai ki agar koi kanoon Article 39(b) (sansadhanon ka saman vitaran) aur 39(c) (dhan-sampatti ke kendra o n shakti ke kendrikaran ko rokna) ko lagu karne ke liye banaya gaya hai, to us par Article 14 aur Article 19 ke teht ye keh kar aakraman (challenge) nahi kiya ja sakta ki wo in adhikaron ka ullanghan karta hai - yaani in do DPSPs ko 14 aur 19 par praadhanikta (precedence) milti hai. 42th sanshodhan ne is chhoot ko sabhi DPSPs tak badhane ki koshish ki thi, lekin Minerva Mills (1980) ne usse vaapas keval 39(b) aur 39(c) tak seemit kar diya. Article 40 gaon panchayat, 44 saman nagar kanoon aur 45-50 bachchon/nishulk shiksha-adivasi kalyan ke nirdesh hain. Exam point: Article 31C ka samrakshan = Article 39(b) aur 39(c) hi (42th wala vistar Minerva Mills 1980 mein rad hua).

qe: Under Article 18, which specific titles are exempted from abolition and legally permitted to be retained?
qh: अनुच्छेद 18 के तहत किन विशिष्ट उपाधियों को प्रतिबंध से छूट दी गई है और उन्हें बनाए रखने की अनुमति है?
e: Article 18 ke teht upadhiyan (titles) samapt ki gayi hain - yani raja-rao aur aise vaibhav-suchak shabdon ki vyavastha hata di gayi; lekin is niyam mein ek chhoot (exception) yahi hai ki 'sainya (military) aur shaikshanik (academic) upadhiyan' ko jaari rakha ja sakta hai, jaise General/Marshal (sainya) aur Padma Shri/Bharat Ratna jaise samman? Dhyaan rahe - Bharat Ratna jaise rashtriya samman 'upadhi' nahi maane jaate, isliye wo is niyam ke daayre mein nahi aate (ispar Supreme Court ne bhi kaha hai ki ye upadhi nahi, samman hain). Article 18(2) ke teht koi bharatiya nagrik kisi videshi rajya se upadhi nahi le sakta. Colonial titles, hereditary aristocratic titles ya dharma sambandhi samman iske apvaad nahi hain. Exam point: Article 18 = upadhiyon ka ant, keval sainya aur shaikshanik upadhiyan sambhav; rashtriya samman (Bharat Ratna) upadhi nahi hain.

qe: The constitutional mandate for the protection of forests and wildlife under Article 48A was added to the DPSP by which amendment?
qh: पर्यावरण और वन्यजीवों की सुरक्षा का संवैधानिक निर्देश (अनुच्छेद 48A) किस संशोधन द्वारा DPSP में जोड़ा गया था?
e: Article 48A 'paryavaran, van aur vanjeevon ki raksha' ka nirdesh hai, jo 42th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1976 ke through DPSP mein joda gaya - usi sanshodhan ne Part IVA mein 10 mool kartavya bhi jode, jismein 51A(g) wala har nagrik ka paryavaran raksha ka kartavya gaya. Iske teht sarkar ne Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980, Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 aur NGT jaisi sansthaayen banaye, jisse pradushan niyantran aur jalwayu (climate) ke mamlon par karyavahi hoti hai. 86th sanshodhan shiksha ke adhikar ke liye tha aur 44th sampti ke adhikar ke liye - isliye 48A ka jod 42th sanshodhan se hi hai. Exam point: Article 48A (van-paryavaran aur vanjeev raksha) = 42th sanshodhan 1976; isi sanshodhan ne mool kartavya (51A) aur 'samajaadi' jaise shabd bhi jode.

qe: The writ of 'Quo-Warranto' is issued by constitutional courts to inquire into:
qh: 'अधिकार पृच्छा' (Quo-Warranto) रिट संवैधानिक अदालतों द्वारा किसकी जांच के लिए जारी की जाती है?
o: The unlawful detention of an undertrial prisoner
The violation of natural justice by a tribunal
The refusal of an executive agency to disburse funds
The legality of a person's claim to a public substantive office created by charter or statute
e: 'Quo Warranto' ka shabdaarth hai 'kis adhikar se' (By what authority) - ye writ tab jaari hoti hai jab kisi vyakti ke kisi 'sarvajanik sthai pad' (public substantive office) par baithne ki vaidhata par sawaal uthe, jaise koi vyakti bina yogya (qualification) ke aise pad par kabja kar le. Ye writ adalat kisi se bhi (keval peedit vyakti hi nahi, koi bhi nagrik) maang sakta hai; isme pad kanoon ya samvidhan dwara bana hona chahiye, niji ya keval honorary pad par ye nahi chalti. Habeas corpus avaidh hirasat ke liye, certiorari nyayik aadesh rad karne ke liye aur mandamus kartavya pura karane ke liye hoti hai - isliye 'pad ke dave ki vaidhata' wala kaam quo warranto ka hai. Exam point: quo warranto = sarvajanik sthai pad par dave ki vaidhata ki jaanch; ise saraam nahi nyayalay se maang sakta.

qe: What does the 'Doctrine of Pith and Substance' determine in constitutional jurisprudence?
qh: संवैधानिक कानून में 'सार और तत्व का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Pith and Substance) क्या तय करता है?
o: Whether a state law is morally acceptable to the public
The exact financial cost of implementing social legislation
The retrospective effect of civil statutes
The true nature and character of a law to determine which legislative list of the Seventh Schedule it substantially falls under, despite incidental encroachments
e: 'Pith and Substance' (mool tatva) ka siddhant do sthaanon - kendra aur rajya - ke vidhayak adhikaron (legislative competence) ke taya (conflict) ko suljhane ke liye istemal hota hai - jaise koi rajya kanoon banata hai aur use lagta hai ki wo kendra ke vishay mein dakhal de raha hai, to adalat dekhti hai ki us kanoon ka 'mool vishay' (true nature and character) kya hai aur wo saaton anusuchi ki kis suchi (Union/State/Concurrent) mein aata hai; saath hi chhoti-mot (incidental) dakhal-andazi ko maaf kiya ja sakta hai. Isi tarah 'colourable legislation' (dhoka-wale vidhan) ka ulata siddhant hai - jismein koi vidhayak mandal apni shakti ke bahar ke vishay ko ghum-phira kar lagu karne ki koshish karta hai. Isliye sahi jod 'mool roop aur charitra se suchi tay karna' hi hai. Exam point: pith and substance = kanoon ka mool vishay dekh kar suchi (list) tay karna; colourable legislation = paroksh roop se shakti ke bahar jaana.

qe: The Right to Education under Article 21A was incorporated into Part III primarily following the landmark judgment in which case?
qh: शिक्षा के अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 21A) को मुख्य रूप से किस ऐतिहासिक मामले के फैसले के बाद भाग III में शामिल किया गया था?
o: Mohini Jain (1992) and Unni Krishnan v. State of Andhra Pradesh (1993)
Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
Indra Sawhney v. Union of India
e: Article 21A aur shiksha ka mool adhikar samvidhan mein aane se pehle adalaton ne is maang ko bal diya - Mohini Jain (1992) ne kaha ki shiksha ka adhikar jeevan ke adhikar ka hissa hai, aur Unni Krishnan v. State of Andhra Pradesh (1993) ne ise 6-14 saal ke bachchon tak seemit kar diya; isi faisle ke baad 86th sanshodhan (2002) ke through Article 21A jodkar baad mein RTE Act 2009 aaya. Kesavananda Bharati basic structure ka, ADM Jabalpur emergency ke dauran habeas corpus par rok ka aur Indra Sawhney (Mandal case) OBC aarakshan ka mamla tha - inse shiksha wala nirnay alag hai. Isliye shiksha ke adhikar ki kahaani in do faislon (Mohini Jain aur Unni Krishnan) se judi hai. Exam point: Article 21A = Mohini Jain (1992) aur Unni Krishnan (1993) ke faislon ke baad 86th sanshodhan se joda gaya.

qe: What did the 24th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1971 clarify regarding Article 13 and constitutional amendments?
qh: 24वें संविधान संशोधन (1971) ने अनुच्छेद 13 और संविधान संशोधनों के संबंध में क्या स्पष्ट किया?
o: The Supreme Court can strike down amendments without reason
Constitutional amendments are completely void if they touch Fundamental Rights
Nothing in Article 13 shall apply to any amendment of the Constitution made under Article 368
State Legislatures must ratify all fundamental right amendments
e: 24th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1971 ne Article 13 mein ek naya khand (Article 13(4)) joda, jo saaf kehta hai ki Article 13 ke pravdhan kisi bhi samvidhan sanshodhan par lagu nahi honge jo Article 368 ke teht kiya gaya ho - iska matlab hai ki Parliament ki sanshodhan-shakti par Article 13 ki 'mool adhikon ka ullanghan' wali rok nahi lagti, kyunki samvidhan sanshodhan samvidhan banane ki shakti (constituent power) hai, samanya kanoon banane ki nahi. Sanshodhan ne rashtrapati ko sanshodhan vidheyak par anumati dene ko bhi baandhne wala bana diya, aur yahi mereed aage 'basic structure' wale Kesavananda (1973) faisle ke liye dhara ban gayi. Adalat sanshodhan ko poori tarah nirast nahi karti; keval basic structure todne par kar sakti hai. Exam point: 24th sanshodhan (1971) ne Article 13(4) jodkar kaha - samvidhan sanshodhan par Article 13 lagu nahi, par basic structure ki seema 1973 se aayi.

qe: Under Article 35 of the Constitution, who alone is empowered to make laws prescribing punishments for acts declared to be offences under Part III (e.g., Articles 17 and 23)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 35 के तहत भाग III के अपराधों (जैसे अनुच्छेद 17 और 23) के लिए दंड निर्धारित करने का कानून बनाने का अधिकार केवल किसे है?
o: The Supreme Court through plenary guidelines
The Union Home Ministry through notifications
e: Article 35 ke anusaar Part III (mool adhikaron) ke teht jo aapraadh ghoshit kiye gaye hain - jaise asprishyata (Article 17) ya manav traficking/forced labour (Article 23) - unke liye saza (punishment) tay karne wale kanoon keval Parliament bana sakti hai, rajya vidhan mandal nahi. Isi tarah khaas mamlon mein mool adhikar lagu karne ki shakti bhi kuchh had tak kendriya vidhan ke through aati hai (Article 33 ke teht sainikon ke adhikar sankuchit karna bhi Parliament ka kaam hai). Isliye 'saza tay karna' ka adhikar kendra ke paas rakh kar samvidhan yahi sunishchit karta hai ki mool adhikar sabhi rajyaon mein ek jaisi suraksha paayen. Supreme Court, rajya vidhan sabha aur grih mantralaya ke paas ye adhikar nahi hai. Exam point: Article 35 = mool adhikaron se jude aapraadhon ki saza ke liye kanoon sirf Parliament bana sakti hai, rajya vidhan mandal ko nahi.

qe: What is meant by the 'Doctrine of Colorable Legislation' in Indian constitutional law?
qh: भारतीय संवैधानिक कानून में 'छद्म विधान का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Colorable Legislation) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Laws enacted during wartime without debate
Legislation dealing with dyes and manufacturing
What cannot be done directly cannot be done indirectly; the legislature cannot overstep its constitutional jurisdiction under the guise of an apparent power
A statute that violates only the Preamble
e: 'Colourable Legislation' (rang-badlan wala vidhan) ka siddhant kehta hai ki jo kaam vidhayak mandal seedhe (directly) nahi kar sakta, wahi kaam wo paroksh (indirect) roop se bhi nahi kar sakta - agar rajya kisi aise vishay par kanoon banata hai jo uski shakti ke bahar hai, par naam badal kar ya parde mein chhupa kar darshata hai ki wo uski shakti mein hai, to aisa kanoon adalat dwara rad kiya ja sakta hai. Ye siddhant keval savera ke 'mukhya vishay' (pith and substance) ko dekh kar nahi, vidhayak ke 'iraade' (intent) par bhi vichaar karta hai; angrezi aam kanoon se aaya hai. 'Yuddh ke dauran bina bahas wale kanoon' ya 'rang-banane ke kanoon' isse bilkul alag baatein hain - isliye sahi arth hi shakti ke bahar ke kaam ko paroksh karne wala vidhan hai. Exam point: colourable legislation = seedhe na kar sakne wala kaam paroksh roop se bhi nahi (vidhayak ke shakti-seema ki raksha ka usool).

qe: Under Article 33 of the Constitution, Parliament is empowered to modify or restrict the application of Fundamental Rights to which category of personnel?
qh: अनुच्छेद 33 के तहत संसद को किस वर्ग के कर्मियों के मौलिक अधिकारों को सीमित करने की शक्ति प्राप्त है?
o: Only convicted undertrials lodged in state prisons
Members of the Armed Forces, forces charged with public order, intelligence organizations, and telecommunication systems set up for these forces
Elected members of municipal councils and corporations
All employees of the central and state civil secretariats
e: Article 33 ke teht Parliament kanoon bana kar sainya balon (armed forces), lok vyavastha (public order) sambhalne wali balon, gupatchar (intelligence) sansthaon aur unke liye bane sanchar (telecommunication) tantron ke sadasyon par mool adhikaron ka prayog seemit ya samapt kar sakti hai - yani in vargon ke logon ko samanya nagrik jitni poori azaadi nahi mil sakti, kyunki unka kaam anushasan (discipline) aur raksha se juda hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki sainikon ke liye alag kanoon (Army Act etc.) aur niyam hote hain. Chunavi sansthaon ke sadasya (municipal councillors), aam sarkari karmachari ya kaidi is pravdhan ke daayre mein nahi aate. Exam point: Article 33 = sainya, public order wali bal, gupatchar sansthan aur unke telecom tantron par mool adhikon ka sanshodhan - keval Parliament ke kanoon se.

qe: The 'Creamy Layer' exclusion principle for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) in public employment was laid down in which landmark case?
qh: सरकारी नौकरियों में अन्य पिछड़े वर्गों (OBC) के लिए 'क्रीमी लेयर' को बाहर करने का सिद्धांत किस ऐतिहासिक मामले में तय किया गया था?
o: Indra Sawhney v. Union of India (1992 - Mandal Case)
Champakam Dorairajan v. State of Madras (1951)
M. Nagaraj v. Union of India (2006)
Jarnail Singh v. Lachhmi Narain Gupta (2018)
e: 'Creamy Layer' (malai wali parat) ka siddhant Indra Sawhney v. Union of India (1992) - jise Mandal Commission case bhi kehte hain - mein Supreme Court ne tay kiya; 9 nyayadhiishon ki bench ne kaha ki OBC (Other Backward Classes) ke liye 27% aarakshan sambhav hai, par un vargon ke aise samuh (kuchh samuh) jo samajik-aarthik roop se aage badh chuke hain (creamy layer) unhe aarakshan se bahar rakhna hoga, aur aarakshan keval prarambhi bharati (initial appointment) mein hoga, padonnati (promotion) mein nahi. Baad mein 77th/85th sanshodhan ne promotion mein SC/ST ko aarakshan diya aur Jarnail Singh (2018) ne creamy layer ko SC/ST promotion par bhi lagu kiya. Champakam Dorairajan (1951) alag (quota wala) mamla tha aur M. Nagaraj (2006) promotion wali data-collection ki shart se juda tha. Exam point: creamy layer = Indra Sawhney (1992, Mandal case): OBC 27% aarakshan par cream layer bahar.

qe: Article 20(3) of the Constitution guarantees protection against 'Self-Incrimination'. What is its scope?
qh: अनुच्छेद 20(3) 'स्व-दोषारोपण' से संरक्षण प्रदान करता है। इसका दायरा क्या है?
o: No person accused of any offense shall be compelled to be a witness against himself in criminal proceedings
A taxpayer cannot be audited by tax authorities
An accused cannot be compelled to give signature samples or thumb impressions
A witness is exempt from answering civil summons
e: Article 20(3) kehta hai ki kisi bhi aapradh ke aaropit (accused) vyakti ko apne khilaf gawahi (witness) dene ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta - yani 'anti-self-incrimination' ka samrakshan milta hai; ye usool angrezi aam kanoon ke 'nemo tenetur se ipsum accusare' se aaya. Iska daayra keval aapradh ke aaropit vyakti tak hai (gawah na, aur keval aapraadhik mamlon mein) - koi bhi sakshya batane ke liye jabar (compulsion) nahi ho sakti; haan, Supreme Court ne kaha hai ki ungliyon ke nishan, blood sample ya signature lena iske daayre mein nahi aata. Tax audit, civil summons ya witness ke sawaal is pravdhan se alag hain, kyunki ye aapraadh ke aaropit wale mamle nahi hain. Exam point: Article 20(3) = aapradh ke aaropit ko khud ke khilaf gawahi dene ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta (testimonial compulsion par rok).

qe: Under Article 22, what is the maximum duration for which a person can be detained under a Preventive Detention law without obtaining the opinion of an Advisory Board?
qh: अनुच्छेद 22 के तहत सलाहकार बोर्ड की अनुमति के बिना किसी व्यक्ति को निवारक निरोध कानून में अधिकतम कितने समय तक हिरासत में रखा जा सकता है?
e: Article 22(4) ke anusaar niruddh (detained) vyakti ko 'preventive detention' mein 3 mahine se adhik samay tak bina 'Salahkaar Mandal' (Advisory Board) ki raay ke nahi rakha ja sakta - yani 3 mahine ke andar Mandal ki report aani chahiye ki hirasat uchit hai; iske alava Article 22(7) ke teht Parliament khaas kanoon bana kar isi seema ko badal bhi sakti hai (jaise COFEPOSA/NdPS wale kanoonon mein 6 mahine/nirvachit avadhi tak). Nirudan (detention) aur giraftari (arrest) alag hain: giraftari ke 24 ghante ke andar nyayadhiish ke saamne peshi hoti hai, par preventive detention mein aarop ka mukadma nahi hota. 1 saal, 24 ghante ya 6 mahine wale vikalp Article 22(4) ke samanya niyam se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: preventive detention mein 3 mahine se zyada ke liye Advisory Board ki raay zaroori (Article 22(4)); Parliament khaas kanoon se ye samay badal sakti hai.

qe: In which landmark judgment did the Supreme Court explicitly establish that the Right to Privacy is a Fundamental Right under Article 21?
qh: किस ऐतिहासिक फैसले में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने स्पष्ट रूप से स्थापित किया कि निजता का अधिकार अनुच्छेद 21 के तहत एक मौलिक अधिकार है?
o: Shayara Bano v. Union of India (2017)
Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India (2017)
Kharak Singh v. State of U.P. (1962)
e: Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India (2017) mein Supreme Court ki 9 nyayadhiishon ki bench ne sarvamat se kaha ki 'nijata ka adhikar' (Right to Privacy) Article 21 ke teht ek mool adhikar hai - ye faisla Aadhaar yojana ki vaidhata ki sunvai ke dauran aaya aur usne purane nirnayon (M.P. Sharma 1954 aur Kharak Singh 1962) ki seemit vyakhya ko badal diya. Is faisle ke baad nijata (privacy) ke samrakshan ke liye teen shartein tay hui - kanoon dwara, uchit lakshya (legitimate aim) aur samanupatik sanket (proportionality). Shayara Bano (2017) teen talaq ka mamla tha, isliye nijata wala nirnay Puttaswamy hi hai. Exam point: nijata ka adhikar mool adhikar = Puttaswamy (2017), Article 21 ke teht (9-judge bench, sarvamat).

qe: Under Article 16(4A), who was provided reservation in matters of promotion with consequential seniority in public services?
qh: अनुच्छेद 16(4A) के तहत सरकारी सेवाओं में परिणामी वरिष्ठता के साथ पदोन्नति में आरक्षण किसे प्रदान किया गया?
e: Article 16(4A) ke teht Scheduled Castes aur Scheduled Tribes ko lok sevaon mein padonnati (promotion) mein aarakshan ka pravdhan hai - ye khand 77th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1995 se aaya, aur 85th sanshodhan, 2001 ne ismein 'parinaamik varshishtata' (consequential seniority) ka shabd joda, jisse padonnati ke baad seniority ka laabh bhi mile. Iske peeche tark yahi hai ki SC-ST vargon ko prarambhik niyukti mein aarakshan milne ke bawajood oopar ke padon par pahunchne mein peeche rah jaate hain. OBC ko Article 16(4) ka aarakshan hai (promotion mein nahi, jaisa Indra Sawhney ne kaha), EWS ko 103th sanshodhan (2019) se faayda mila, aur alpsankhyakon ko sashastr balon ke liye alag pravdhan hai. Exam point: promotion mein aarakshan + consequential seniority = SC/ST (Article 16(4A), 77th aur 85th sanshodhan).

qe: What does the 'Doctrine of Severability' under Article 13(1) prescribe regarding unconstitutional statutory provisions?
qh: अनुच्छेद 13(1) के तहत 'पृथक्करणीयता का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Severability) क्या निर्धारित करता है?
o: The entire legislation is automatically voided if any single word conflicts with Fundamental Rights
The law remains valid until Parliament reviews it within one year
Only the specific provision that is inconsistent with Fundamental Rights is declared void, provided the valid portion can operate independently
The offending law is transferred to the Ninth Schedule
e: 'Severability' (alag-alag karne ka) siddhant Article 13(1) ke teht kehta hai ki agar kisi kanoon ka koi hissa mool adhikaron ka ullanghan karta hai, to poora kanoon nirast nahi hota - keval wahi anuchhed/dhara (provision) nirast hoti hai jo mool adhikaron se takrati hai, aur baaki kanoon khud kaam karta rahega, agar nirast hisse ko hata kar bacha hua kanoon svatantr roop se chal sakta ho. Yeh usool R.M.D.C. v. Union of India (1957) mein spasht kiya gaya. 'Poora kanoon nirast' wala vikalp galat hai kyunki usse vidhaayika ka kaam vaajib se zyada nashth hota; Ninth Schedule mein bhejne ka rasta alag (sanrakshan) vyavastha hai. Exam point: severability = keval vah dhara nirast jo mool adhikar todti hai, agar bacha hua kanoon svatantr chal sake; Article 13(1) ka siddhant.

qe: What does the 'Doctrine of Waiver' establish in Indian constitutional jurisprudence regarding Fundamental Rights?
qh: भारतीय संवैधानिक न्यायशास्त्र में 'त्याग का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Waiver) मौलिक अधिकारों के बारे में क्या स्थापित करता है?
o: Only corporate entities can waive constitutional rights
A citizen CANNOT waive or give up any of their Fundamental Rights, as they are matters of public policy and constitutional obligation
The State can waive fundamental rights for government employees
A citizen can voluntarily surrender or waive their Fundamental Rights by signing a contract
e: 'Doctrine of Waiver' (tyag karne ka siddhant) ke anusaar koi bhi nagrik apne mool adhikaron (Fundamental Rights) ko tyag (waive) nahi kar sakta - chahe wo likhit samjhauta (contract) kar le, unhe chhod nahi sakta, kyunki ye adhikar keval uske vyaktigat laabh ke nahi, balki lok niti (public policy) aur samvidhanik kartavya ke roop mein diye gaye hain. Isliye adalat vyakti ke 'haan, maine tyag kiya' kehne par uske mool adhikar ki raksha karna band nahi karti; ye usool Basheshar Nath v. Commissioner of Income Tax (1959) mein charchit hua (kuchh nyayadhiishon ne alag raay di thi). Haan, un adhikaron ka prayog (exercise) kisi samay nhi karna (jaise bhaashn na dena) alag baat hai - tyagnama (waiver) alag baat. Exam point: mool adhikon ka tyag sambhav nahi (public policy), isliye aisa likhit samjhauta bhi adalat mein nahi chalega.

qe: What is the core procedural difference between the writ of 'Prohibition' and the writ of 'Certiorari'?
qh: 'प्रतिषेध' (Prohibition) और 'उत्प्रेषण' (Certiorari) रिट के बीच मुख्य प्रक्रियात्मक अंतर क्या है?
o: Prohibition is issued against executive officers, while Certiorari is issued against judges
Both writs perform identical functions without distinction
Prohibition is preventive (issued while proceedings are pending to prevent excess of jurisdiction), whereas Certiorari is curative (issued after an order has been passed to quash an illegal decision)
Prohibition can only be issued by the Supreme Court, whereas Certiorari is exclusively issued by High Courts
e: 'Prohibition' aur 'Certiorari' mein mukhya antar samay (timing) ka hai: Prohibition ek 'rokne wali' (preventive) writ hai jo us samay jaari hoti hai jab nyayik ya quasi-judicial karyavahi chal rahi ho aur usmein adhikar (jurisdiction) ke bahar jaane ka khatra ho - yani aage badhne se pehle rok dena. Certiorari ek 'sudhaarne wali' (curative) writ hai jo aadesh (order) ho jaane ke baad, usse rad (quash) karne ke liye bulayi jaati hai. Dono writ niche wali adalat/tribunal ke khilaf chalti hain, rashtrapati/Rajyapal ke khilaf nahi; aur 'sirf Supreme Court' ya 'sirf High Court' wali baat galat hai - Article 32 ke teht SC aur Article 226 ke teht HC dono de sakti hain. Isliye sahi antar 'preventive vs curative' hi hai. Exam point: prohibition = karyavahi ke dauran rokne wali, certiorari = aadesh ke baad rad karne wali; dono nyayik ya quasi-judicial karyavahi ke khilaf.

qe: Under Article 20(1), what constitutional protection is guaranteed against 'Ex-post facto laws'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 20(1) के तहत 'पूर्वव्यापी कानूनों' (Ex-post facto laws) के खिलाफ क्या सुरक्षा दी गई है?
o: Taxation laws can never be applied retroactively
No person can be convicted of any offense except for violation of a law in force at the time of the commission of the act, nor subjected to a penalty greater than that prescribed at that time
A person can be tried twice for the same offense if penalties are enhanced
Civil damages cannot be recovered retrospectively
e: Article 20(1) 'ex-post-facto' kanoonon ke khilaf samrakshan deta hai - iske anusaar kisi vyakti ko us karyavahi ke liye saza nahi di ja sakti jo us samay kanoon ke teht aapraadh nahi thi, aur na usse us samay ke nirdharit dand (penalty) se zyada bada dand diya ja sakta hai. Ye samrakshan keval aapradhik (criminal) kanoonon par lagu hota hai, civil ya kar (tax) sambandhi kanoonon par nahi; aur trial ki prakriya (procedure) ke liye ye rok nahi hai - nayi prakriya purane mamle mein bhi lagu ho sakti hai. Isliye vikalp 'taxation laws retroactive nahi' ya 'do baar saza' wali baatein galat hain; 20(2) double jeopardy alag hai. Exam point: Article 20(1) = kanoon se pehle ka aapraadh nahi aur us samay ke dand se zyada dand nahi (keval criminal kanoonon par lagu).

qe: In the landmark 'Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978)' case, how did the Supreme Court revolutionize Article 21?
qh: 'मेनका गांधी मामले (1978)' में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अनुच्छेद 21 की व्याख्या में क्या क्रांतिकारी बदलाव किया?
o: Held that the procedure depriving a person of life or personal liberty must be 'just, fair, and reasonable', effectively merging 'due process of law' into 'procedure established by law'
Excluded foreign travel from the ambit of personal liberty
Restricted personal liberty to mere physical freedom from bodily restraint
Declared that Fundamental Rights are mutually exclusive separate codes
e: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978) mein Supreme Court ne Article 21 ki poori samajh badal di - usne kaha ki 'procedure established by law' ka matlab koi bhi procedure nahi, balki 'nyayapurn, uchit aur tarksangat' (just, fair and reasonable) procedure hai; is tarah America ke 'due process of law' ka saar Article 21 mein aa gaya. Iske alava adalat ne kaha ki Article 14, 19 aur 21 ek doosre se alag-alag dweep (mutually exclusive) nahi hain - kisi bhi karyavahi ko teeno ki kasauti par parkha jaayega, isliye 'procedure' mein sunvai (hearing) ka mauka bhi shaamil hai. Isi faisle ke baad passport rokne jaisi karyavahi par bhi Article 21 ka aadhar mila. Exam point: Maneka Gandhi (1978) = Article 21 ka 'procedure' nyayapurn-uchit-tarksangat hona chahiye; 14, 19, 21 ek saath padhe jaate hain.

qe: The 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019 introduced which reservation provisions by amending Articles 15 and 16?
qh: 103वें संविधान संशोधन (2019) ने अनुच्छेद 15 और 16 में संशोधन करके क्या प्रावधान किए?
o: Horizontal 33% reservation for women in Parliament
Reservation for transgender communities in public sector units
Up to 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) in education and public employment, over and above existing quotas
e: 103th samvidhan sanshodhan, 2019 ne Article 15 aur 16 mein sanshodhan karke 'Aarthik Roop Se Kamzor Varg' (Economically Weaker Sections - EWS) ke liye shiksha (school/college) aur sarkari naukri mein 10% aarakshan ka pravdhan joda - ye aarakshan existing quota (SC/ST/OBC ke aarakshan) ke upar (over and above) hai, aur 50% ki seema ko chhod kar alag rakha gaya. Iska aadhar yahi tark tha ki aarthik roop se peeche logon ko bhi mauka mile jo saamaajik aadhaar par aarakshan nahi paate; chalne wale mamlon mein adalat ne ise 50% wali seema mein na ginte hue EWS ke liye alag jagah ka vichaar kiya. Mahilaon ke liye 33% aarakshan (106th sanshodhan), OBC 27% aur transgender ke liye alag pravdhan 103th sanshodhan ke nahi hain. Exam point: 103th sanshodhan (2019) = EWS ko 10% aarakshan (Article 15(6) aur 16(6)), existing quota ke upar.

qe: Under Article 34 of the Constitution, what power is conferred upon Parliament when Martial Law is in force in any area?
qh: अनुच्छेद 34 के तहत किसी क्षेत्र में मार्शल लॉ लागू होने पर संसद को क्या शक्ति प्राप्त है?
o: Parliament may by law indemnify any person in the service of the Union or a State for acts done in connection with the maintenance or restoration of order
The Supreme Court jurisdiction is abolished permanently
Parliament must surrender all fiscal powers to the army
e: Article 34 ke anusaar jab kisi kshetra mein 'martial law' (sainya shasan) lagu ho, to Parliament kanoon bana kar us kshetra mein order banaaye rakhne ya bahal karne ke liye kiye gaye kaam ke liye kisi bhi vyakti ko 'muafi' (indemnity) de sakti hai - yani aise adhikariyon ke khilaf baad mein muqadma nahi chalaya ja sakta jinhone order bahaali ke liye kadam uthaye. Ye pravdhan samvidhan mein likha hua nahi hai ki martial law kab aur kaise lagta hai - ye ek angrezi parampara hai aur Article 34 hi uske liye samvidhanik aadhar deta hai. Article 34 'sainya shasan ke mamle mein muafi' se juda hai, sansad (Parliament) ko dissolve karne ya samvidhanik adhikar chhine jaane ka isse koi sambandh nahi hai; isliye sahi jod 'Parliament muafi de sakti hai' hi hai. Exam point: Article 34 = martial law ke dauran/baad order bahaal karne ke liye kiye kaam par Parliament 'indemnity' ka kanoon bana sakti hai.

qe: In the 'Ramlila Maidan Incident (2012)' case, the Supreme Court recognized which basic human right as an integral component of Article 21?
qh: रामलीला मैदान मामले (2012) में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने किस अधिकार को अनुच्छेद 21 का अभिन्न अंग माना?
o: Right to contest elections without party tickets
Right to sleep peacefully without arbitrary state disruption
e: Ramlila Maidan Incident (2012) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki 'shaantipoorvak sona' (right to sleep) Article 21 ke teht ek aadharik manav adhikar hai - raat ke samay bina uchit saanketik (unlawful) roop se logon ko jagane aur jabar-dast (force) se uthane ki karyavahi jeevan aur daivi swatantrata ka ullanghan hai; ye nirnay badantam ke baad ek shaanti se sone wale samuh par police karyavahi ke mamle mein aaya tha. Iske alava Article 21 ke vistaar mein anek adhikar shaamil kiye gaye hain - ghoomne-phirne ki azaadi, bhookh se mukti, svasthya, nijata (privacy) aur internet tak pahunch (Puttaswamy aur Anuradha Bhasin 2020). 'Chunav ladne ka adhikar', 'consumer dispute' ya 'internet access' mein se internet ek baad ke faisle ka vishay hai, par Ramlila Maidan ka nirnay neend ka adhikar hi hai. Exam point: Ramlila Maidan (2012) = shaantipoorvak sone ka adhikar Article 21 ka hissa; bina kaaran force se uthana adhikar ka ullanghan.

qe: What did the Supreme Court hold in 'Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation (1985)' regarding pavement dwellers?
qh: 'ओल्गा टेलिस मामले (1985)' में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने फुटपाथ पर रहने वालों के संबंध में क्या निर्णय दिया?
o: Street vendors are exempt from civil municipal laws
Pavement dwellers have no constitutional rights
The Right to Livelihood is an integral part of the Right to Life under Article 21, as no person can live without the means of living
e: Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation (1985) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki 'rozg ar/zindagi ke saadhan' (right to livelihood) Article 21 ke 'jeevan ke adhikar' ka hissa hai - kyunki zinda rehne ke saadhan ke bina jeevan ki kalpana nahi ki ja sakti; isliye pavement par rehne wale ya jhuggiwasiyon ko bina uchit sune sunaye aur paryapt vaikalpik jagah diye bina nahi hataya ja sakta. Isi tarah adalat ne kaha ki rajya ki karyavahi 'vidhipurn prakriya' (procedure established by law) ke tahat honi chahiye, warna wo jeevan ke adhikar ka ullanghan hogi. Isliye pavement wale niwasiyon ke adhikar ko bina jaanch ke khatm karna uchit nahi maana gaya, aur unhe hatane ke liye sunvai aur vaikalpik vayavastha zaroori thi. Exam point: Olga Tellis (1985) = rozgar/jeevan-yapan ka adhikar Article 21 ke andar; jhuggiwasiyon ko hatane se pehle sunvai aur rehabilitation dena zaroori.

qe: Under Article 27 of the Constitution, what restriction is placed on the State regarding public revenues and religion?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 27 के तहत सार्वजनिक राजस्व और धर्म के संबंध में राज्य पर क्या रोक लगाई गई है?
o: Religious institutions are prohibited from holding bank accounts
The State cannot collect any municipal fees from religious shrines
No person shall be compelled to pay any taxes, the proceeds of which are specifically appropriated in payment of expenses for the promotion or maintenance of any particular religion
Foreign donations to religious organizations are banned
e: Article 27 ke anusaar koi bhi vyakti kisi aise kar (tax) dene par jabar nahi kiya ja sakta jiska upyog kisi ek vishesh dharm ke pracar ya rakh-rakhav ke liye kiya jaata ho - yani sarkar ke paas ye azaadi nahi hai ki wo hindu/muslim/isai kisi ek dharm ke liye kar laga kar us dharm ko badhaye, kyunki isse dharmik samanata (secularism) bhang hogi. Dhyaan rahe ki ye rok keval 'kar' (tax) par hai - samanya kar (jaise aay-kar) ya dharmik sansthaon se li jaane wali 'fees' (utpaad, jaise tirath-sthal ka ticket, jagah ka kiraya) iske daayre mein nahi aate. Bank accounts par rok, mandir se municipal fees lena ya videshi chanda rokna is pravdhan ke vishay nahi hain. Exam point: Article 27 = vishesh dharm ke pracar ke liye kar (tax) nahi lagaya ja sakta; Article 26 sansthaon ke mamle aur Article 25 azaadi se juda hai.

qe: What was established by the Supreme Court in the historic 'Champakam Dorairajan (1951)' case?
qh: 'चंपाकम दोराईराजन मामले (1951)' में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने क्या फैसला सुनाया जिसके कारण पहला संविधान संशोधन हुआ?
o: Communal caste-based quota in state medical colleges violated Article 29(2), leading Parliament to enact the First Constitutional Amendment adding Article 15(4)
e: Champakam Dorairajan vs State of Madras (1951) mein Supreme Court ne madras sarkar ke us aadesh ko nirast kiya jismein medical college mein jaati ke aadhaar par 'samudaayik quota' (communal G.O.) diya gaya tha - adalat ne kaha ki ye Article 29(2) (rajya-anudan wale sansthaon mein pravesh mein bhedbhav nahi) ka ullanghan hai aur samvidhan mein sirf mool adhikar hain, DPSP un par praadhaanik nahi ho sakte. Is faisle ke baad Parliament ne 1st Constitutional Amendment, 1951 laaya jisne Article 15(4) joda, jisse picchde vargon ke liye shiksha sansthaon mein vishesh pravdhan ka raasta khula. Isliye is faisle ka asar yahi tha ki aarakshan ko samvidhanik aadhar dene ke liye Article 15(4) jodna pada; EWS ya panchayat se iska koi sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: Champakam Dorairajan (1951) = jaati-aadharit quota Article 29(2) ke khilaf, iske baad 1st Amendment se Article 15(4) joda gaya.

qe: Under Article 19(1)(c), does the fundamental right to form associations or unions include the fundamental right to strike or declare lockouts?
qh: क्या अनुच्छेद 19(1)(c) के तहत संघ या यूनियन बनाने के अधिकार में हड़ताल (Strike) करने का मौलिक अधिकार भी शामिल है?
o: Yes, the right to strike is an absolute fundamental right
No, the right to form unions is a fundamental right, but the right to strike or lockout is merely a regulated legal/statutory right governed by industrial dispute statutes
e: Article 19(1)(c) ke teht sangh ya union (association) banane ka adhikar ek mool adhikar hai, lekin ismein 'hartaal karne ka adhikar' (right to strike) shaamil nahi hai - Supreme Court ne All India Bank Employees Association v. National Industrial Tribunal (1962) mein kaha ki sangh banane ka adhikar alag baat hai aur hartaal karna alag; hartaal keval 'vaidhanik/kanooni' (legal/statutory) adhikar hai jo Industrial Disputes Act jaise kanoonon ke teht milta hai, jahan uski shartein aur seemayein hain. Isi tarah lockout (malki bandi) bhi isi seema ke andar aata hai. Toh azaadi ka sahi arth 'sangh banana' tak hai, hartaal ya lockout utpann karne tak nahi; isliye 'hartaal bhi mool adhikar hai' wala vikalp galat hai. Exam point: Article 19(1)(c) = sangh/union banane ka mool adhikar, hartaal ka nahi; hartaal ek statutory adhikar hai (industrial kanoon ke teht).

qe: What is the crucial legal distinction between 'Equality before the Law' and 'Equal Protection of the Laws' under Article 14?
qh: अनुच्छेद 14 के तहत 'कानून के समक्ष समानता' और 'कानूनों के समान संरक्षण' के बीच क्या कानूनी अंतर है?
o: 'Equality before the law' (British origin) is a negative concept denoting absence of special privileges, whereas 'Equal protection of the laws' (American origin) is a positive concept demanding equal treatment of persons under similar circumstances
Both are identical concepts borrowed from France
'Equal protection' applies only to foreign citizens
'Equality before law' applies only in military courts
e: Article 14 mein do milte-julte par shabd hain: 'vidhi ke samaksh samanata' (equality before law) ek negative (rokne wala) vichaar hai jo British aam kanoon (common law) se aaya - iska arth hai ki koi vyakti kanoon se upar nahi hai aur kisi ko bhi vishesh suvidha nahi milegi. Iske ulat 'vidhiyon ki saman suraksha' (equal protection of the laws) ek saaka (positive) vichaar hai jo American samvidhan se aaya - iska arth hai ki samaan paristhitiyon mein sabhi ke saath saman vyavhar hona chahiye, yani rajya kuchh vargon ke liye vishesh pravdhan kar sakta hai agar uske peeche uchit tark ho (jaise mahilaon/bachchon/picchde vargon ke liye saak (positive) karyavahi). Isliye 'British vs American' wala jod sahi hai, aur dono ek hi cheez nahi hain. Exam point: equality before law = negativ, British; equal protection of laws = saaka (positive), American; dono Article 14 mein ek saath likhe hain.
